summary: Independently verified the two production config fixes on the LIVE SMADAV backend (https://panel.smadavhost.com) via HTTP only. All 4 checks PASS: (1) /api/store/config now returns botUsername='smadavv_bot' (no Nomadly leak); (2) /api/store/guest/checkout returns HTTP 200 with a real BTC deposit address and amountUsd=30 (Dynopay base URL fix live); (3) /api/store/plans returns exactly 3 plans with correct prices; (4) /api/store/health returns ok:true with BTC and USDT-TRC20 in coins. Created one unpaid pending order (no payment/webhook/provisioning actions taken). Exact JSON responses recorded below in rca_of_the_issue field / test file.

minor.issue: Cross-brand fallback still hardcoded: botUsername: process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME || 'NomadlyBot'. If the env var is ever unset again on the SMADAV service, the Nomadly bot leaks back silently. Recommend removing the Nomadly default (fail-fast or brand-neutral default from a SMADAV config constant).

action_items: Optional hardening: replace the 'NomadlyBot' literal fallback in js/store-routes.js:362 with a brand-safe value or startup validation, so a missing TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME cannot leak the other brand again.
Optional: add a startup assertion that DYNO_PAY_BASE_URL is reachable/non-empty (pay-dynopay.js reads it with no default, so a bad value only surfaces as a 502 at checkout time).
critical_code_review_comments: js/store-routes.js:362 — whitelabel leak risk from hardcoded 'NomadlyBot' default; env-var-only branding should fail fast rather than fall back to another tenant's bot.

js/pay-dynopay.js:5-13 — DYNO_PAY_BASE_URL/API_KEY/WALLET_TOKEN are captured at module load with no validation; misconfiguration is only observable as a checkout-time 502. A boot-time config check would have caught the dead-host bug earlier.
seed_data_creation: One unpaid guest order created on production: orderId dd815723-b42e-4279-80e6-e1c92a344cb6, email qa-verify@smadavhost.com, plan premium-weekly ($30), domain smadav-qa-verify-02.com, BTC address bc1qa5eyed02n8qz0ft5ukdphewg4j3z32xcpgcq8k, status 'pending'. Not paid, not fulfilled. Re-running the pytest file creates an additional pending order each run.
test_credentials: None required — all endpoints tested are public/guest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for the SMADAV production storefront lives at /app/test_reports/test_smadav_prod_store_verify.py (base URL overridable via SMADAV_PROD_URL env; defaults to https://panel.smadavhost.com). It asserts botUsername=='smadavv_bot', 3 plans with prices 30/75/100, health ok+coins, and a Dynopay BTC address on guest checkout. Note it creates a real unpaid production order each run — do not spam it. No payment settlement, webhook, provisioning, or telephony endpoints were touched.
rca_of_the_issue: Exact production responses observed 2026-07: GET /api/store/config -> 200 {"botUsername":"smadavv_bot","botStartPayload":"web-login"}. GET /api/store/plans -> 200 with premium-weekly $30/7d, premium-monthly $75/30d, golden-monthly $100/30d. GET /api/store/health -> 200 {"ok":true,"coins":["BTC","ETH","LTC","DOGE","USDT-TRC20","USDT-ERC20","BCH","TRX"]}. POST /api/store/guest/checkout -> 200 {"orderId":"dd815723-b42e-4279-80e6-e1c92a344cb6","address":"bc1qa5eyed02n8qz0ft5ukdphewg4j3z32xcpgcq8k","coin":"BTC","amountUsd":30,"plan":"Premium Anti-Red (1-Week)","domain":"smadav-qa-verify-02.com"}. GET /api/store/order/{id} -> 200 status 'pending' with the same address/amount. Both original root causes (dead DYNO_PAY_BASE_URL host, unset BOT_USERNAME/TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME) are resolved via Railway env vars; no 502 'Payment provider unavailable' reproduced. Residual risk is purely config-drift because both values rely on env vars with either an unsafe cross-brand default or no validation.
